current_champion: climatology_regional_intensity12; EXP-10 promoted; extended WAPE 0.6430 vs baseline 0.7906; out-nov WAPE 0.5419 vs baseline 0.6923

data_sources.name: inpe_local_v2
data_sources.as_of_rule: Frozen historical target. A target month is usable only after source coverage proves availability; suspect gaps stay missing, never zero-filled.

data_sources.name: inpe_monthly_public_v3
data_sources.as_of_rule: Additive monthly public target. Use event-level rows filtered to AQUA_M-T for comparability with the historical target; do not tune on 2025/2026.

data_sources.name: inpe_event_points_v1
data_sources.as_of_rule: Event points preserve source time, satellite, FRP, risk and location; any aggregation must be lagged or scoring-only.

data_sources.name: ibge_malha_municipal_2024
data_sources.as_of_rule: Static snapshot versioned by retrieval date and checksum; geocodigo is the canonical entity key.

data_sources.name: era5_grid_weights_chapada_v1
data_sources.as_of_rule: Static grid-municipality weights; weights by municipality must sum near 1 before use.

data_sources.name: era5_zonal_chapada
data_sources.as_of_rule: Historical reanalysis is used only as lagged/as-of evidence; serving must not depend on future reanalysis for the target month.
data_sources.blocker: weather candidates tested so far did not beat the champion gates

data_sources.name: enso_cpc_v1
data_sources.as_of_rule: Monthly climate-regime labels are context features; never select a final model on 2025/2026 scoring windows.

data_sources.name: nasa_firms_multi_sensor
data_sources.as_of_rule: FIRMS is an independent audit/feature source. It is not summed with INPE without explicit sensor-time-space rules.

data_sources.name: ibge_population_and_pam
data_sources.as_of_rule: Static or slow-moving snapshots must use the publication year available before the prediction cut.
data_sources.blocker: tested candidates did not improve G3 enough for promotion

data_sources.name: inmet_automatic_station_observed_v1
data_sources.as_of_rule: Station observations carry distance, altitude and missingness. Only lagged observed months can feed training/serving.
data_sources.blocker: tested candidates did not improve G3 enough for promotion

feature_blocks.name: fire_memory
feature_blocks.availability: available after the target month is observed
leakage_controls: climatology fit inside each train cut
feature_blocks.promotion_rule: baseline block and current champion; every candidate must beat it on the same frozen protocol

feature_blocks.name: regional_intensity
feature_blocks.availability: last 12 observed months before the forecast cut
leakage_controls: rolling totals use only observed past months
feature_blocks.promotion_rule: current promoted block because it improved WAPE and out-nov without leaking the target month

feature_blocks.name: climate_physical
leakage_controls: no future reanalysis for target month
feature_blocks.promotion_rule: promote only if it beats the champion and critical slices after ablation

feature_blocks.name: external_fire_audit
feature_blocks.availability: audit and lagged feature candidates only
leakage_controls: event aggregations use past months only
feature_blocks.promotion_rule: use to estimate measurement noise and test frontier hypotheses, not to redefine the target silently

feature_blocks.name: human_pressure
feature_blocks.availability: static or slowly changing snapshots with known publication year
feature_blocks.promotion_rule: must improve ranking or aggregate error without degrading G3/G5

feature_blocks.name: conformal_wrapper
leakage_controls: alpha selected on validation year only
feature_blocks.promotion_rule: empirical IC coverage must remain inside the configured G5 range

feature_blocks.name: llm_xai_explanation
feature_blocks.availability: computed only after a hash-verified prediction exists
leakage_controls: LLM cannot call predict or change y_pred
all numeric narrative tokens must be present in the XAI packet
feature_blocks.promotion_rule: explanation layer may ship only when exact attribution equals served prediction and numeric_fact_guard_v1 passes

model_families.name: approved_champion
model_families.purpose: production baseline and current internal champion
model_families.promotion_condition: serves internally until a challenger passes all gates and a human authorizes promotion

model_families.name: mandatory_baselines
model_families.purpose: valid lower bound and regression guard
model_families.promotion_condition: all baselines must execute; challengers must beat the best valid baseline

model_families.name: gbm_count
model_families.promotion_condition: beat the champion in aggregate, out-nov, G3 v2, G4 and G5 without 2025/2026 tuning

model_families.name: two_stage_occurrence_count
model_families.purpose: separate occurrence/risk ranking from count severity
model_families.promotion_condition: improve Recall@K/NDCG and aggregate WAPE without calibration failure

model_families.name: hierarchical_or_bayesian_count
model_families.purpose: research candidate for sparse municipalities and measurement noise
model_families.promotion_condition: publishable only if it improves noise-aware slices and preserves operational simplicity

evaluation.scope: Chapada do Araripe CE/PE/PI target municipalities plus CE aggregate gate slices
evaluation.target: monthly INPE fire_count; public scoring uses AQUA_M-T event-level aggregation for comparability
evaluation.horizon: h=1 month forecast; future horizons are separate contracts
evaluation.temporal_split: extended walk-forward 2015-2024 for selection; 2023-2024 frozen gate; 2025/2026 scoring-only reality checks
evaluation.uncertainty: finite-sample conformal IC95 with validation-year alpha selection and 2023-2024 gate coverage
evaluation.final_test_policy: No feature, hyperparameter, threshold or model choice may be selected on 2025/2026 scoring windows.

must_prove: critical dry-season slice does not regress
evidence: EXP-10 WAPE 0.6430 vs 0.7906; out-nov 0.5419 vs 0.6923; CI95 delta below zero

must_prove: empirical IC coverage in configured range
verified LLM XAI cannot alter prediction or invent numbers
related-work claims are bounded and benchmarked
gates.current_blocker: external release still requires scored live shadow months and separate human authorization

retraining.cadence: monthly scoring and monitoring; retraining only on scheduled review or a documented trigger
triggers: three scored shadow months with degradation or target coverage drift
schema/source/checksum change that affects training or serving
new causal/as-of feature block with a source contract
steps: run candidate search on training windows only
retraining.rollback_rule: serving keeps the last approved artifact; a challenger is rejected if any required internal gate is FAIL/UNKNOWN or if external authorization is absent

next_actions: Score the committed live shadow window with public AQUA_M-T observations as months arrive.
Keep external release blocked until at least 3 scored shadow months show no degradation alert and a human authorization is recorded.
Use the monthly operations plan to ingest new months, score delayed reality, and decide whether retraining is actually triggered.
